name: skill-router
description: Manage installed Codex skills based on usage. Reports last-used time per skill, suggests stale ones, and disables them by renaming SKILL.md files.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and manage stale Codex skills
interface.longDescription: Skill Router audits Codex skills, suggests unused or stale entries, and safely disables selected skills by renaming SKILL.md files so they can be restored later.
